source: policy rollout (learned ACT policy on a Jetson Orin Nano Super; not teleoperation)
task: Pick up the cola can and place it upright on the coaster

outcome.rule: can standing upright on the coaster at the end (geometric judge on the overhead video) AND gripper released AND no human contact

operator_note: The grasp was off, and the can dropped while being carried.

trajectory.state: observation.state: follower joint positions read at each control step
trajectory.action: command sent to the follower at that step (the policy output after chunk blending, clipped to the motor limits)
trajectory.units: shoulder_pan..wrist_roll in degrees; gripper 0-100 (position, not force)
trajectory.space: joint space; no end-effector pose is recorded

chunk_timing.note: one entry per 100-step action chunk request

sync.rule: frame i of each video is the camera image observed at control step i; state[i] was read at the same step and action[i] was sent right after
sync.clock: videos are encoded at a nominal 30 fps, but control steps are not evenly spaced (median 33.3 ms, max 281 ms); use t_wall_s for real time, not frame_index / 30
